notes: Game and save paths now correct themselves. Browse, dragging a shortcut on, and picking a save folder all rewrite what they got to use the Windows variable for the folder it came from - %USERPROFILE%\Desktop, %APPDATA%, %PUBLIC%\Desktop, %ProgramFiles% and the rest - so a path added once follows the account the terminal signs into and works on every machine instead of naming one computer. A path inside somebody else's account is still left alone and flagged, because no variable can make that one work; the page now also says, quietly, when a row follows the signed-in account and so needs its own copy of the file on each desktop.
